changelog:
- Initial release of the announcement-card skill.
- Generates concise, visually-structured announcement cards for launches, milestones, hires, and more.
- Output includes a bold headline, one-line summary, 2–3 proof points, and a clear call to action.
- Supports export as a PNG card for sharing on LinkedIn, X, Slack, etc.
- Provides alternate headlines, a caption for post body, and channel-tailored notes.
summary: Write a short, punchy announcement designed to be shared as an image or social card. Use when asked to announce a launch, milestone, feature, hire, funding,...
